gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold issue concerns undefined or unbounded point evaluation on L2 equivalence classes and the resulting failure of sampling operators to be well-defined. ISSUE-001 concerns an incorrect MN scaling identity and a missing tail estimate in a width proof; it does not diagnose the evaluation-domain or representative problem.

The gold issue establishes that the log-normal inverse weights fail to be summable for permitted eta and requires the substantive restriction eta>2/q. ISSUE-003 only identifies an unquantified eta symbol in a different holomorphic theorem and proposes adding a quantifier; it does not recognize the inverse-weight summability failure or its threshold condition.

The gold issue concerns undefined affine Jacobi weight factors and failure of inverse-weight summability under the stated radii, including the need for corrected normalization and admissible-radius conditions. ISSUE-003 concerns only quantifying eta in a separate holomorphic theorem and supplies no diagnosis of the affine weights, radii, or summability contract.
